item.title: Version 0.8.0-alpha.19
item.description:
What's Changed

  • appcast: v0.8.0-alpha.18 by @github-actions[bot] in #466
  • Correct context sender attribution and add mobile recent-pane navigation by @btucker in #467
  • Recover iOS notification history and application scrolling by @btucker in #468
  • Fix native Cmd-click abort after snapshot restore by @btucker in #469
  • Bound SSH terminal queues and close canceled attachments by @btucker in #471
  • Bound queued WebSocket terminal output by @btucker in #470
  • Clarify team delegation and use controlled English messages by @btucker in #463
  • Mobile: event-driven first-line clearance, cached theme, one keyboard subscription per split tree by @btucker in #498
  • Keep the window header at the top with no terminal open by @btucker in #499
  • Bound the 2-second liveness and port pollers with 5s subprocess timeouts by @btucker in #495
  • Remote: share the SSH-over-DataChannel transport and WebRTC peer helpers by @btucker in #500
  • Mac: split GrafttyApp.swift into per-responsibility files (PR 1 of #478) by @btucker in #503
  • Mac: make the control-socket router a SocketRequestRouter type (#478 step 3a) by @btucker in #510
  • Run CLIRunner and LinuxHostSSHRunner on one subprocess core by @btucker in #504
  • Simplify Context history and link source worktrees by @btucker in #506
  • Mac: move WebRTC host agent pool wiring out of startup() (#478 step 3b) by @btucker in #514
  • Extract RepoPollScheduler for stats, PR, and remote-branch polling by @btucker in #505
  • Document why GitAutoTracking avoids poll abandonment by @btucker in #515
  • Mobile: re-check first-line clearance after reflow and content replacement (fixes #508) by @btucker in #509
  • Keep FSEvents callback contexts alive through stream teardown by @btucker in #502
  • Mac: move native team delivery wiring into NativeTeamDelivery (#478 step 3c) by @btucker in #517
  • Mobile: split TerminalInputContainerView into per-concern files by @btucker in #501
  • GrafttyKit perf: TeamInbox parse cache, opt-in content FSEvents, single-ref rev-list (#473) by @btucker in #518
  • Remote: shared SubsystemChannel/TypedRequestHandler; RPC deadlines fire on WebRTC by @btucker in #513
  • Add graftty pane add --agent and reword one-agent-per-worktree guidance by @btucker in #511
  • Mobile: move SingleSessionView and sidebar row views into their own files (#492 PR 1) by @btucker in #524
  • JSONFileStore + collapse identity/device-ID store pairs (#488, 1/2) by @btucker in #523
  • Remaining JSON stores on JSONFileStore + ObservableListStore (#488, 2/2) by @btucker in #526
  • Mac: share one TrustedPeerStore and host identity via AppServices (#478 step 4) by @btucker in #521
  • One WorktreeEntry→WorktreePanes projection, converter and state bridge (#484 part 1) by @btucker in #520
  • CI: lint Linux test allowlist for silently skipped GrafttyKitTests files (#529) by @btucker in #531
  • Share sidebar pane-title, attention-capsule and divergence views via GrafttyCommandUI (#492 PR 2) by @btucker in #528
  • Remote byte path: single-copy relays, shared ELG and coders, snapshot wait (#474) by @btucker in #536
  • Teams: render the Codex wrapper from a bundled .sh template (#487 part 2) by @btucker in #534
  • Share one control-socket dispatcher between the Mac app and the headless host (part of #481) by @btucker in #519
  • Mac: route host-managed pane commands through one dispatcher (#478 step 2) by @btucker in #538
  • Mobile: one init per list view, shared providers, layout-await helper, single selection write (#492 PR 3) by @btucker in #542
  • Mac: delete dead Codex delivery helpers and progress-report plumbing (#478 step 6) by @btucker in #539
  • Speed up CI without reducing test coverage by @btucker in #516
  • Store WorktreePanes worktree attention once (#484 part 2) by @btucker in #535
  • Mac: move pane statics into enum PaneCommands (#478 step 1) by @btucker in #540
  • Teams: one TeamDeliveryPipeline for Codex and Claude native delivery (#487 part 1) by @btucker in #532
  • Remote: share the V2→V1 panes-state subscription between Mac and iOS (#491 part 1) by @btucker in #551
  • Mobile: provide the remote connection coordinator through the environment (#492 PR 4) by @btucker in #548
  • Share one split direction enum and move RepoInfo to GrafttyProtocol (#484 part 3) by @btucker in #537
  • Mac: AppState worktree mutation helpers and one attention auto-clear (#478 step 5) by @btucker in #541
  • Remote: one RemoteHostLink protocol for both host transports (#491 part 2) by @btucker in #552
  • Mac: ZmxPaths and AppServices team accessors (#478 step 5) by @btucker in #543
  • Move Codex app-server registration and team presence resolution into GrafttyKit (#482 part 4) by @btucker in #566
  • Test REMOTE-11.24 ordering deterministically instead of spinning (#558) by @btucker in #559
  • Remote: LatestValueBroadcast and WorktreePanesStore.frameUpdates() (#493 PR 1) by @btucker in #569
  • Remote: share the signed SDP negotiation between Mac and iOS (#491 part 3) by @btucker in #556
  • Mac: dedupe the panes-state poll loop, remote launch lookup, host-key startup and native-delivery retry (#478 step 7) by @btucker in #570
  • Mac: project sidebar rows once per body and only the selected worktree's repository (#480 PR A) by @btucker in #576
  • Freeze control-socket wire JSON for every request and response (#482 part 0) by @btucker in #560
  • Retire the team_message wire case; keep team msg as a hidden alias (#482 part 5) by @btucker in #568
  • Remote: release broadcast values outside the lock (#569 follow-up, #493) by @btucker in #587
  • Mobile: push worktree updates to the iPhone attention count (#493 PR 2) by @btucker in #574
  • Separate context history entries from attention status by @btucker in #557
  • CI: keep SwiftPM workspace state with the dependency cache by @btucker in #585
  • CI: stop cancelling in-progress main runs on the next merge by @btucker in #563
  • One generic CLI response check instead of eight exhaustive switches (#482 part 1) by @btucker in #584
  • Stop TEAM-10.11 from hanging when the cooperative pool is saturated by @btucker in #598
  • Carry the widest team requests as Codable payload structs (#482 part 2a) by @btucker in #590
  • Mac: query Tailscale status off the main actor (#472 part 1) by @btucker in #582
  • Mobile: push worktree frames into the worktree list (#493 PR 3) by @btucker in #575
  • Mac: debounce the whole-state save off the main actor (#472 part 2) by @btucker in #607
  • Mac: save AppState changes made with no window open (#472 part 3) by @btucker in #612
  • Mac: rebuild sidebar navigation on an AppState change signal instead of every second (#480 PR B) by @btucker in #588
  • Carry create_worktree and add_pane as Codable payload structs (#482 part 2b) by @btucker in #592
  • Mac: RemoteWorktreeViewerController with queue tests (#479 part 1) by @btucker in #597
  • Mac: MainWindow drives remote panes through RemoteWorktreeViewerController (#479 part 2) by @btucker in #600
  • Mac: send panes-state frames on the AppState change signal instead of polling every second (#480 PR C) by @btucker in #599
  • Probe every needed capability with one capabilities request (#482 part 3) by @btucker in #602
  • Delete SocketServer's synchronous onRequest branch (#476 part 1) by @btucker in #615
  • Make TEAM-10.11 independent of the cooperative and GCD pools by @btucker in #617
  • Delete test-only seams and no-op calls in GrafttyKit and the Mac app (#476 part 2) by @btucker in #621
  • Mobile: one worktree feed for the iPad layout; delete onListChanged (#493 PR 4) by @btucker in #608
  • Route .showPane through the shared read-and-tail step (#476 part 4) by @btucker in #625
  • Delete the dead agentTeamsEnabled flag and its teamsEnabled threading (#476 part 3) by @btucker in #623
  • Mac: publish the AppState change signal on every persister mark, with or without a window (#480 follow-up) by @btucker in #614
  • Delete the test-only sendBinary entry points and lastReceivedBinary (#476 part 5) by @btucker in #626
  • Wire File → Add Repository… (⇧⌘O) to the window's add-repository action by @btucker in #628
  • Mobile: delete the legacy /ws transport, orphan session files, and ignored parameters (#476 part 6a) by @btucker in #630
  • Add GrafttyTestSupport and GrafttyKitTestSupport test targets (#477 part 1) by @btucker in #637
  • Mobile: drop the HTTP fallbacks behind the relayed worktree providers (#476 part 6b) by @btucker in #634
  • Mobile: host IPAD-1.24 only with the sidebar collapsed (#646) by @btucker in #649
  • Mobile: Add Worktree sheet lists repositories only over the paired connection (closes #476) by @btucker in #638
  • Share worktree create/remove between the Mac app and the headless host (#481 step c) by @btucker in #639
  • Mac: one WorktreeManagement service behind REST, the paired-device envelope and the CLI (#483 1/3) by @btucker in #642
  • Gate IOS-7.4's reconnect assertion on the channel failure (#632) by @btucker in #643
  • Drive IOS-6.28's held-arrow repeat with a manual scheduler (#620) by @btucker in #644
  • Mac: default-branch pull, repo list and session lookup through WorktreeManagement (#483 2/3) by @btucker in #647
  • Return a piped subprocess's output on exit instead of waiting for pipe EOF (#650) by @btucker in #651
  • Linux smoke: bound apt-get so a mirror stall fails fast with a diagnostic by @btucker in #578
  • Compile GrafttyKitTests on Linux by default; exclude Apple/ and a pending list (#477 part 2, slice 1) by @btucker in #654
  • Share one LoopbackPeer across the WebRTC loopback tests (#477 part 3) by @btucker in #662
  • Port the Git test suites to Linux: shared /bin/sh helper (#477 part 2, slice 2) by @btucker in #660
  • Web REST: one route table and shared POST/provider bridges (#483 3/3) by @btucker in #668
  • PORTS-5.44: drive the build-lock fixture by handshakes and ordering, not deadlines (#583) by @btucker in #670
  • Gate the web client's WorktreePanes mirror on the host wire fixture (#477 part 4) by @btucker in #665
  • Convert the @mainactor PRStatus XCTests to Swift Testing (#477 part 2, slice 3) by @btucker in #669
  • CHROME-5.1/5.2: include VirtualClock.swift in the project-generation fixture by @btucker in #680
  • Refuse a web, paired-device or sidebar delete of a worktree still being created or removed (#640) by @btucker in #677
  • TEST-1.14: bound LoopbackPeer data-channel waits by @btucker in #682
  • CI: run the macOS and iOS jobs on the self-hosted Mac for same-repo refs by @btucker in #674
  • Mobile: host IPAD-1.24's feed without the split view (#657) by @btucker in #664
  • Port the Darwin-socket, Web TLS-context and LAN listener tests to Linux (#477 part 2, slices 4-5) by @btucker in #673
  • Bind numeric host addresses without name resolution (#678) by @btucker in #685
  • Close #477: describe the Linux pending test list by its own blockers by @btucker in #689
  • Bound remote pane-control waits in the Mac viewer by @btucker in #692
  • Remove wall-clock races from polling, subprocess, and paged-terminal tests by @btucker in #694
  • Validate team senders against pane presence by @btucker in #699
  • Add AWS host enrollment and Dev Container worktrees with parent MCP by @btucker in #711
  • Cover retained mobile RootView layout transitions (#648) by @btucker in #707
  • Compile the iOS test target on Swift 6.4 (closes #698, #705) by @btucker in #708
  • Restore zoom and report legacy remote split timeouts by @btucker in #702
  • Use Codex thread identity after an empty session ID (#565) by @btucker in #712
